summary.en: Kogoro was hired by Yoshihiro Tsuchida to protect him, but failed because he is murdered. Location: Goldfish Investments company Victim: Yoshihiro Tsuchida Cause of death: Blunt force trauma Suspects: Atsuko Bando and Mitsuru Kitamura When they heard a scream, Kogoro and Conan headed inside the building, and found Tsuchida dead near the entrance of his office. After Kogoro and Conan saw Tsuchida's body, they later find the dead Yuto Kajiura, president's secretary. Location: Goldfish Investments company Victim: Yuto Kaijura Cause of death: Stab wound on the chest Suspects: Atsuko Bando and Mitsuru Kitamura They then turned their heads and saw another body lying in the adjacent room, the dead Yuto Kajiura.
